summary: Adeia Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that CEO Paul E. Davis resigned as chief executive officer and board member effective October 12, 2026, to focus on health and personal pursuits. The board accepted the resignation and, on the transition committee's recommendation, appointed Dipti Vachani, 53, a nearly 30-year semiconductor veteran from Arm, Intel and Skyworks, as successor CEO and director effective the same date. Davis will serve as a consultant through December 31, 2026, for a fixed $183,000 fee. No deal terms, advisors or regulatory clock apply; this is an abrupt CEO transition event, with execution continuity and strategy an obvious watch item.
